verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that session cookies can be passed via the `X-Set-Cookie` header and that Reader forwards them when fetching the URL, which directly covers authenticated-page fetching. The evidence is a single brief mention, with no detail on syntax, multiple cookies, interaction with the browser engine or cache, and no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: detailed cookie-format and behavior documentation (e.g. caching or engine interaction with cookies), independent or hands-on corroboration that authenticated pages are fetched successfully.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass my own session cookies so the API fetches pages requiring authentication

citations.quote: Pass your session cookies with the `X-Set-Cookie` header and the Reader forwards them when fetching the URL
